issue.title: test_load_launchable_prunes_provider_mismatched_prefix: provider-mismatch pruning drops the genuine bare-git #git:otherproj entry
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-16n.11.3 (epic sase-16n.11, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1): the test fails on a clean tree and is unrelated to the project-tag display fixes.

Re-verified by the sase-16n.11 land agent at master 848a90a1b (workspace sase_34):

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider "tests/test_vcs_xprompt_mru_pruning.py::test_load_launchable_prunes_provider_mismatched_prefix"
    AssertionError: assert ['#gh:sase'] == ['#gh:sase', '#git:otherproj']

Deterministic (fails on every run, serially). Not caused by the project-tag epics: it fails the same way with the current venv at 3844ed83d, 2b883ef01, and every sase-16n commit checked (19895a01b, eea59a651, 3bf3b998a, 394a53b6d, 4f1177f2c). Those runs used a detached worktree with PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src.

Narrowed down: wrapping the four pruning predicates in `load_launchable_vcs_xprompt_mru_pairs` (src/sase/history/vcs_xprompt_mru.py) shows `_vcs_prefix_provider_mismatched` prunes BOTH `#git:gh_sase-org__sase` (expected) and `#git:otherproj` (unexpected). The test monkeypatches `sase.workspace_provider.detect_workflow_type` to return "git" for otherproj, so either the detection is not going through that patch or `_workflow_and_ref_for_prefix` parses `#git:otherproj` into a different workflow type. The second is suspected: it iterates `get_ref_patterns()`, whose order depends on the installed provider plugins (sase-github is installed from the linked checkout here). The exact root cause is not yet pinned down, so it may depend on the host or plugin setup.

fields.description: Deterministic failure of a VCS-MRU pruning test on clean master, proposed by sase-16n.11.3 and re-verified by the sase-16n.11 land agent. Evidence and narrowing are in the CI-failure section below.

payload.description: Earlier retry/visual lane task; unrelated root cause, listed only as prior MRU-adjacent lane history

payload.entry: The 'related bead:sase-13v' artifact link on this task was added by mistake by the sase-16n.11 land agent: sase-13v is about the retry-e2e visual lane and has nothing to do with this MRU pruning failure. Ignore it. 'sase artifact link rm -R related bead:sase-13v bead:sase-172' fails with 'validation: observed_operation_ids must not be empty', so the link could not be removed.

evidence.note: Proposed by sase-1eq.3.1.3 note 1 (formerly tests/test_vcs_xprompt_mru_pruning.py, now tests/test_vcs_macro_mru_pruning.py): independently reproduced on clean master 0676975ef3 after just install, both in the 157-test proposal-verification batch and a fresh serial rerun. test_load_launchable_prunes_provider_mismatched_prefix returns [#gh:sase], expected [#gh:sase, #git:otherproj], exactly the pre-rename failure in this task. This task predates epic sase-1eq.3.1 by nine days; note 1 characterized its full-suite pass as order dependence, so preserve that observation too. No new task.

Independent repro while landing sase-1eq.4.1 (proposed by phase sase-1eq.4.1.5 note #4): tests/test_vcs_macro_mru_pruning.py::test_load_launchable_prunes_provider_mismatched_prefix fails deterministically at master 9f8c4c529e and on pre-epic base e847b082c2 (targeted pytest -n 8 run in a scratch worktree), so it predates and is unrelated to sase-1eq.4.1.

Relayed from sase-1eq.2 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1 and re-reproduced by sase-1eq.land on 2026-10-05 at sase 17c2907d3b (file renamed to tests/test_vcs_macro_mru_pruning.py): a serial raw pytest run still fails with assert ['#gh:sase'] == ['#gh:sase', '#git:otherproj'], and unsetting every SASE_* env var does not change it. Narrowing: the same node PASSED inside the governed sase tool run check full-suite escalation (ToolRun 51278da441aaf76a90201ed609b54b59, 52669 passed), so the result depends on test order or process state, not only on host plugins.
